_meta.note: DEMO ONLY - fictional roster. Maps recorder class codes to the fictional teacher (and, for RM12, the fictional student) from the samples. Class codes are matched case-insensitively with spaces, hyphens and underscores treated alike (common/classcodes.py). The board classes come from the recorder's built-in sample lists (firmware/recorder-idf/main/sample_device.json). The real class-code-to-student mapping lives only in the school's project (checklist row 12).

iep_goals.description: When experiencing sensory overload, Marcus will independently request or use a calming strategy (e.g., noise-canceling headphones, break space) and return to task within 5 minutes in 4 of 5 opportunities.
Marcus will solve double-digit addition problems with regrouping at 80% accuracy across three consecutive probes.

usr_demo_sarah.note: Fictional demo teacher. 'Demo Teacher' is the recorder's built-in sample label.
usr_demo_sarah._emails_note: Sign-in emails of the real person acting as this demo teacher (hosted review screen: only they, or a demo admin, may approve / download). Fill in, e.g. the reviewer's email; empty = demo admins only.

iep_access._note: The school's IEP access setting for RBTs: read (default) or none. none = RBTs get sessions without IEP goal evaluations.

rbt_demo_rm12.name: Demo RBT
rbt_demo_rm12._emails_note: Sign-in emails of the demo RBT (fictional). Allowlist role must be rbt. An RBT is read-only: they read every classroom, session and student, but never parent emails, and can't edit, approve, export or move a session. Their list opens filtered to these class_codes.
